name: Daniel Morgan
role: Commander, Provisional Rifle Corps; victor of Cowpens
portrayal: The Old Wagoner: teamster's shoulders, a back scarred by 499 British lashes from the last war (he joked they miscounted and owed him one — documented), profane, shrewd, beloved. The anti-aristocrat counterweight to the Continental officer corps.

documented_beats.event: Turkey-call signals rallying his riflemen at Freeman's Farm
Riflemen sweep the light infantry at Bemis Heights
Explains the Cowpens plan around the fires the night before — militia asked for two volleys, withdrawal planned as a feature
The double envelopment destroys Tarleton's Legion in about an hour

gameplay_notes: Command Moments: Cowpens is the mode's proof of concept (docs/09 M5). In campaign Path D, his firelight briefing is the game's best mission briefing — the player hears the plan the militia heard, in the register they heard it.
